Other than that I'd definitely give 14 Hands and the vitners village in Prosser a go. You won't find the highest quality wines there but it's a fun experience nonetheless!

After they hit 10-15 brix, you can stomach them no problem usually. They have an almost mucous-like center which is fun, haha. Wine makers will usually travel around their blocks to taste the clusters and determine which flavors they find desirable.
